disposition_reason: Original AAS measurements of Pb, Cd and Zn in intestine, heart, liver and gizzard of local market chickens from three Tamil Nadu districts.

study.design: Market survey of local chicken organs and blood
study.origin: Local chickens, Tamil Nadu (rearing not stated)
study.market: Local and central markets in Coimbatore, Erode and Namakkal districts, Tamil Nadu, India
study.method: AAS after HNO3/HClO4 wet digestion of oven-dried organs

unresolved: Table 1 Heart Cd in Coimbatore is printed "ND", defined in the footnote as "Not done"; no finding recorded.
Blood results (Table 1) are biological samples, not food; not extracted.
Abstract mentions breast tissue, but no breast muscle results are reported; heart appears instead.
Text values (e.g., cadmium highest 0.72 mg/kg in Namakkal gizzard; lead range 2.40-3.43 mg/kg intestine) conflict with Table 2 ranges.
No sample numbers, collection dates, LOD, CRM or recovery data are reported.
The footnote defines ND as "Not done" while the text treats ND as not found; ambiguity unresolved.
